arxiv-1803-02228.title: A lower bound for the Bogomolny and Schmit constant for random monochromatic plane waves
arxiv-1803-02228.creator: Maxime Ingremeau, Alejandro Rivera
arxiv-1803-02228.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Let f:\mathbb{R}^{2}\rightarrow\mathbb{R} be the stationary, isotropic planar centered almost surely continuous Gaussian field 1 1 1 We refer the reader to [ Abr97 ] for the definition and properties of random fields. with covariance \mathbb{E}[f(x)f(y)]=J_{0}(|x-y|) where J_{0}(r)=\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{0}^{2\pi}e^{ir\sin(\theta)}d\theta is the 0 th Bessel function of the first kind. We call this field the random monochromatic plane wave .

arxiv-2012-11766.title: Forbidden Dark Matter Annihilations into Standard Model Particles
arxiv-2012-11766.creator: Raffaele Tito D’Agnolo, Di Liu, Joshua T. Ruderman, Po-Jen Wang
arxiv-2012-11766.description: Abstract We present kinematically forbidden dark matter annihilations into Standard Model leptons. This mechanism precisely selects the dark matter mass that gives the observed relic abundance. This is qualitatively different from existing models of thermal dark matter, where fixing the relic density typically leaves open orders of magnitude of viable dark matter masses.

arxiv-2107-10476.title: A Deep Learning-based Quality Assessment and Segmentation System with a Large-scale Benchmark Dataset for Optical Coherence Tomographic Angiography Image
arxiv-2107-10476.creator: Yufei Wang, Yiqing Shen, Meng Yuan, Jing Xu, Bin Yang, Chi Liu, Wenjia Cai, Weijing Cheng, Wei Wang
arxiv-2107-10476.description: Abstract Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCTA) is a non-invasive and non-contacting imaging technique providing visualization of microvasculature of retina and optic nerve head in human eyes in vivo . The adequate image quality of OCTA is the prerequisite for the subsequent quantification of retinal microvasculature. Traditionally, the image quality score based on signal strength is used for discriminating low quality.

arxiv-2410-18222.title: Kubo-Martin-Schwinger states of Path-structured Flow in Directed Brain Synaptic Networks
arxiv-2410-18222.creator: Elkaïoum M. Moutuou, Habib Benali
arxiv-2410-18222.description: Abstract The brain’s synaptic network, characterized by parallel connections and feedback loops, drives interaction pathways between neurons through a large system with infinitely many degrees of freedom. This system is best modeled by the graph C*-algebra of the underlying directed graph, the Toeplitz-Cuntz-Krieger (TCK) algebra, which captures the diversity of path-structured flow connectivity.

arxiv-2411-14991.title: Free Energy Projective Simulation (FEPS): Active inference with interpretability
arxiv-2411-14991.creator: J. Pazem, M. Krumm, A. Q. Vining, L. J. Fiderer, H. J. Briegel
arxiv-2411-14991.description: Abstract In the last decade, the free energy principle (FEP) and active inference (AIF) have achieved many successes connecting conceptual models of learning and cognition to mathematical models of perception and action. This effort is driven by a multidisciplinary interest in understanding aspects of self-organizing complex adaptive systems, including elements of agency.
